neighbours.label: describing the orientation or placement of an object: which way it faces, which side it sits on, at what angle it is held
fire: In Britain the driver sits on the right, so the gear stick is on the left.
Hold the camera at a slight angle so the lens points down at the table.
Traditional mosques are oriented so that the prayer wall faces Mecca.
Place the ladder so its feet are one metre from the wall and the top leans inward.
On a standard keyboard the escape key sits at the top left corner.
Mount the solar panel facing south and tilted at about thirty degrees.
The bed was turned so that the headboard faced the east window.
Angle the knife blade at twenty degrees against the sharpening stone.
quiet: In Britain petrol is expensive, so many people cycle to work instead.
Use a fast shutter speed when you photograph children playing.
Traditional mosques are often funded by donations from the community.
Buy a ladder that is light enough to carry around the garden.
On a standard keyboard the keys are made of hard plastic.
The solar panel cost less than we expected and arrived in a week.
The bed was delivered on Tuesday and assembled by my brother.
Keep the knife clean and dry after each use in the kitchen.
